stories.title: Two workers pulled from Nepal hydropower tunnel nine days after flash flood
new_facts: Establishes new story: Nepal flood survivors rescued from tunnel via search for buried entrance, blasting rocks.
Two hydropower tunnel workers pulled alive 9 days after Nepal floods; others believed trapped alive.
Floods caused by Aug. 26 glacier collapse; early warning signs existed but monitoring systems insufficient.
Death toll now exceeds 1,200; hundreds more people believed still trapped.
New estimate: a dozen other workers believed trapped in the tunnel system.
stories.line: Two workers rescued from a Nepal hydropower tunnel nine days after a flash flood trapped them; more voices detected inside suggest additional survivors.

stories.line: Volkswagen will cut 100,000 jobs by 2030 as the automaker restructures to cut costs amid industry shift to electric vehicles.
